sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Add internal tags to your products to group, filter, and manage campaigns more efficiently.

sections.heading: What Are Product Tags?
sections.body: Tags are internal labels that help you organize and segment products within Trellis. They do not sync to Amazon and are only used for internal workflows.

sections.heading: Ways to Use Tags
sections.body: Use tags to group Top Performers or Seasonal Products, identify New Launches or Clearance Items, track High Margin or Low Inventory products, and build targeted Media Plans or custom reports.

sections.heading: How to Add Tags
sections.body:
1. Go to Reports -> Product Report, or any page where products can be selected.
2. Use filters or search to find the products you want to tag.
3. Select one or multiple products using the checkboxes.
4. Click Bulk Actions -> Add Tag.
5. Enter a new tag name or select from existing tags.
6. Click Apply.

sections.heading: Tip
sections.body: You can apply multiple tags to a single product. Tags are searchable in reporting and campaign filters, which makes them useful for organizing work across teams.

sections.heading: Example Use Cases
sections.body:
Seasonal planning: Q4 Products, Holiday Gift Guide
Profit-based grouping: High Margin, Low Margin
Product lifecycle: New Launch, Discontinued Soon
Ad targeting: Priority SKUs, Brand Awareness Set
